s: We refer to these targets as "difficult-to-drug." Contour's computational software uses artificial intelligence and sophisticated algorithms to model the assembly of molecular fragments, which are chemical structures consisting of one to several atoms, into fully elaborated, drug-like structures that precisely fit each target's 3-dimensional binding site.
Contour's proprietary artificial intelligence experientially optimizes performance in subsequent iterations.
